a5210:
# jeff-chat: Alex and JEFF talking, in the Conversation (a5080). The feed groups a run of lines by one writer under one
# name; Alex's own lines stand at the right. "Everything" shows every line anyone said to or by Alex, anywhere; JEFF
# chooses what reaches Alex now, and the whole feed is always here to read. The draft (role=conversation-draft,
# actor=$me) holds who it goes to (to), what it answers (reply_to, quote) and which feed is shown (view).
chat : column
  share 1
  role chat
  of prop:role=conversation-draft,prop:actor=$me as draft
  each room
room : column
  share 1
  role room
  head : row
    role chathead
    face : text "J"
      role face
    who : column
      share 1
      name : text "JEFF"
        role chatname
      state : text "thinking…"
        role thinking
        only when count(house doing=working resident=jeff) > 0
      rest : text "here when you want him"
        role meta
        only when count(house doing=working resident=jeff) = 0
    tabs : row
      role tabs
      all : text "All"
        role tab
        role tab.on when ($draft.view or "") != "jeff-only"
        on click when ($draft.view or "") = "jeff-only" do prop $draft view=all
      mine : text "Just JEFF"
        role tab
        role tab.on when ($draft.view or "") = "jeff-only"
        on click when ($draft.view or "") != "jeff-only" do prop $draft view=jeff-only

  hello : column
    role hello
    only when count(sayings in:a5080) = 0
    hi : text "JEFF is new, as of today."
      role heading
    what : text "He keeps the whole picture: what the residents and builders are doing, what is waiting on you, and what can wait. Ask him anything, or ask for the lowdown."
      role meta
  feed : column
    share 1
    scroll end
    role feed
    only when ($draft.view or "") = "jeff-only"
    of sayings in:a5080 as s
    clamp last 120
    run name
    each said
  everything : column
    share 1
    scroll end
    role feed
    only when ($draft.view or "") != "jeff-only"
    of sayings involving:alex as s
    clamp last 120
    run name
    each said
  working : row
    role working
    of house doing=working as h
    each typing
  dock : column
    role dock
    let vopen = (max($viewing of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me) or "")
    let about = ($draft.topic or "")
    let wview = (max($view of prop:role=writer,prop:actor=$me) or "")
    let qin = (max($quote_in of prop:role=writer,prop:actor=$me) or "")
    let qwords = (max($quote of prop:role=writer,prop:actor=$me) or "")
    let wopen = (max($open of prop:role=writer,prop:actor=$me) or "")
    let held = qwords when wview = "conversation" and qin != "" and qwords != "" and (qin = vopen or qin = wopen)
    let held = "" otherwise
    let elsewhere = "yes" when ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" and ($draft.reply_in or "") != "" and $draft.reply_in != "a5080"
    let elsewhere = "no" otherwise
    topic : column
      only when held = "" and ($draft.reply_to or "") = "" and ($draft.reply_thread or "") = ""
      chip : row
        role answering
        only when ($draft.topic or "") != ""
        label : text "About $draft.topic"
          role aboutname
          share 1
          clamp 1
        lifetime : text "next message only"
          role meta
        remove : text "×"
          role tool
          tip "Remove context" "Send without the attached item"
          on click do prop $draft topic=""
      offer : row
        role tagline
        only when ($draft.topic or "") = "" and vopen != "" and vopen != "a5080"
        attach : text "Attach open item"
          role tool
          tip "Attach open item" "Include this named item with your next message only"
          on click do prop $draft topic=$(vopen)
        name : text "$(vopen)"
          role aboutname
          clamp 1
    answering : row
      role answering
      only when ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != ""
      q : text "Answering: $draft.quote"
        role meta
        clamp 1
        share 1
      in : text "in $draft.reply_in"
        role meta
        clamp 1
        only when elsewhere = "yes" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != ""
      x : text "×"
        role tool
        on click do prop $draft reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
    commenting : column
      role commenting
      only when held != ""
      the prop:role=writer,prop:actor=$me as w
      on : column
        the $w.quote_in as d
        let talk = ($d.talk or "")
        let isnote = "yes" when $d.kind = "note"
        let isnote = "no" otherwise
        let pointing = ($w.quoting or $d.item)
        let ptext = join($text of $w.quoting) when isnote = "no"
        let ptext = "" otherwise
        let around = $d.text when isnote = "yes"
        let around = ptext otherwise
        let wbefore = (words-before(around, held) or "")
        let wafter = (words-after(around, held) or "")
        let wheading = (section-of($d.text, held) or "") when isnote = "yes"
        let wheading = "" otherwise
        let route = $d.author when ($d.author or "") != "" and $d.author != $me
        let route = $d.owner when ($d.owner or "") != "" and $d.owner != $me
        let route = "jeff" otherwise
        let rules = "A conversation about this document between Alex and its author; anyone may be called in with @name. Keep each message short: one point. If you took his point, change the document and say so in one line with mark=folded. Ask only what you need from him, with mark=ask. To point at a passage: do append <this chat> line=<your words> about=<the document or its paragraph> quote=<its words>."
        what : row
          role answering
          k : text "Comment on"
            role meta
          q : text "“$(held)”"
            role meta
            clamp 2
            share 1
          x : text "×"
            role tool
            on click do read $w; do prop $w quote="" quoting="" quote_in=""
        where : row
          role tagline
          in : text "in $d.item"
            role meta
            clamp 1
          new : text "· goes to $(route), kept in its Talk"
            role receipt
            only when talk = ""
          old : text "· goes to the people of its Talk"
            role receipt
            only when talk != ""
        say : text ""
          role input
          hint "Your comment on these words…"
          lines 1..12
          commit explicit
          on edit when talk != "" and (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append $d.talk line="$value" about=$(pointing) quote="$(held)" words_before="$(wbefore)" words_after="$(wafter)" heading="$(wheading)"; read $w; do prop $w quote="" quoting="" quote_in=""; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
          on edit when talk != "" and not (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append $d.talk line="$value" about=$(pointing) quote="$(held)" words_before="$(wbefore)" words_after="$(wafter)" heading="$(wheading)"; read $w; do prop $w quote="" quoting="" quote_in=""
          on edit when talk = "" and (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do look f3402; do create f3402 kind=chat title="Talk: $d.title" talk_of=$d.item with="$me,$(route)" describe="$(rules)"; read $d.item; do prop $d.item talk=$new; do append $new line="$value" about=$(pointing) quote="$(held)" words_before="$(wbefore)" words_after="$(wafter)" heading="$(wheading)"; read $w; do prop $w quote="" quoting="" quote_in=""; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
          on edit when talk = "" and not (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do look f3402; do create f3402 kind=chat title="Talk: $d.title" talk_of=$d.item with="$me,$(route)" describe="$(rules)"; read $d.item; do prop $d.item talk=$new; do append $new line="$value" about=$(pointing) quote="$(held)" words_before="$(wbefore)" words_after="$(wafter)" heading="$(wheading)"; read $w; do prop $w quote="" quoting="" quote_in=""
    to : row
      role to
      only when held = "" and elsewhere = "no" and ($draft.reply_thread or "") = ""
      label : text "To"
        role meta
      j : text "JEFF"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "jeff"
        on click do prop $draft to=jeff
      s : text "Sable"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "sable"
        on click do prop $draft to=sable
      p : text "Pike"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "pike"
        on click do prop $draft to=pike
      u : text "Juniper"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "juniper"
        on click do prop $draft to=juniper
      r : text "Rowan"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "rowan"
        on click do prop $draft to=rowan
      c : text "Claude"
        role chip
        role chip.on when $draft.to = "claude"
        on click do prop $draft to=claude
    attachments : column
      only when held = ""
      of captures $draft.context
      each attachment
    say : text ""
      role input
      only when held = ""
      hint "Write to JEFF, or anyone above…"
      lines 1..12
      commit explicit
      on edit when elsewhere = "no" and ($draft.reply_thread or "") = "" and (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append a5080 line="$value" default_to="$draft.to" captures="$draft.context" context_from="$draft" reply_to="$draft.reply_to" about="$(about)"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
      on edit when elsewhere = "no" and ($draft.reply_thread or "") = "" and not (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append a5080 line="$value" default_to="$draft.to" captures="$draft.context" context_from="$draft" reply_to="$draft.reply_to" about="$(about)"
      on edit when elsewhere = "yes" do append $draft.reply_in line="$value" reply_to="$draft.reply_to"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
      on edit when ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "" do comment $draft.reply_in id=$draft.reply_thread line="$value"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
    footer : row
      role urfooter
      only when held = ""
      help : text "Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line · @name to send to someone else · Ctrl+Alt drag to show JEFF something"
        role hint
        share 1
      quota : row
        lens home-usage
    helpc : text "Enter sends your comment to the document's Talk · it shows here, with who it went to · × goes back to talking to JEFF"
      role hint
      only when held != ""
said : column
  role said
  role said.mine when $s.name = "alex"
  head : row
    role saidhead
    only when $run = 1
    who : text "$s.by"
      role who
      role who.jeff when $s.name = "jeff"
    to : text "to $s.to"
      role meta
      only when $s.to != "" and $s.to != "alex" and $s.to != "jeff"
    at : text "$s.at"
      role meta
    where : text "in $s.in"
      role place
      only when $s.item != "a5080"
  bubble : column
    role bubble
    role bubble.mine when $s.name = "alex"
    role bubble.jeff when $s.name = "jeff"
    quoted : text "“$s.quote”"
      role chatquote
      clamp 3
      only when ($s.quote or "") != ""
    body : text "$s.said"
      marks
      role words
      media
      on pop do prop prop:role=media-player,prop:actor=$me src="$value" opened=$now
      on pop host window media-player
    more : column
      only when $s.context != ""
      fold "What was shown"
      what : text "$s.context_summary"
        role meta
  tagline : row
    role tagline
    only when ($s.about or "") != "" or ($s.name = "alex" and $s.item != "a5080")
    k : text "about"
      role meta
      only when ($s.about or "") != ""
    what : text "$s.about"
      role aboutname
      clamp 1
      only when ($s.about or "") != ""
    sent : text "sent to $s.to"
      role receipt
      only when $s.name = "alex" and ($s.to or "") != ""
    nobody : text "sent to no one: say @name to call someone"
      role receipt
      only when $s.name = "alex" and ($s.to or "") = ""
  acts : row
    role acts
    answer : text "Answer"
      role tool
      on click when $s.what = "line" do prop $draft reply_to=$s.line quote="$s.said" reply_in=$s.item reply_kind=line reply_thread="" topic=""
      on click when $s.what != "line" do prop $draft reply_thread=$s.thread quote="$s.said" reply_in=$s.item reply_kind=$s.what reply_to="" topic=""
typing : row
  role typingrow
  dots : text "• • •"
    role dots
  who : text "$h.resident is working"
    role meta
attachment : row
  role attachment
  pic : text "$thumb"
    picture
    role attachthumb
    only when ($thumb or "") != ""
  label : text "$label"
    role meta
    share 1
  remove : text "Remove"
    role tool
    on click do prop $draft context="$remaining"
abouting : column
  let open = $v.viewing when ($v.viewing or "") != "" and $v.viewing != "a5080"
  let open = "" otherwise
  on : row
    role abouthead
    only when open != "" and open != ($draft.unabout or "")
    k : text "About"
      role aboutkey
    what : text "$v.viewing"
      role aboutname
      clamp 1
      share 1
    note : text "what you write goes with it"
      role meta
    x : text "×"
      role tool
      tip "Not about it" "Your lines stop carrying what is open in the middle, until you open something else"
      on click when ($draft.unabout or "") != $v.viewing do prop $draft unabout=$v.viewing
  off : row
    role tagline
    only when open != "" and open = ($draft.unabout or "")
    k : text "Not about what is open"
      role meta
      share 1
    back : text "About it again"
      role tool
      on click when ($draft.unabout or "") != "" do prop $draft unabout=""
a5086:
window : column
  share 1
  role page
  header : row
    role header
    title : text "Conversation"
      share 1
      role title
    live : text "AGORA"
      role brand
  subtitle : text "One place to talk, wherever you are working."
    role subtitle
  feed : column
    share 1
    scroll end
    role feed
    of sayings involving:alex
    clamp last 80
    each message
  compose : column
    of prop:role=conversation-draft,prop:actor=$me as draft
    each writing
message : column
  role message
  role mine when $name = "alex"
  role question when $mark = "ask"
  head : row
    who : text "$by"
      role author
      share 1
    at : text "$at"
      role meta
  destination : text "to $to"
    role meta
  place : text "$in"
    role place
    only when $item != "a5080"
  body : text "$said"
    marks
    role body
    media
    on pop do prop prop:role=media-player,prop:actor=$me src="$value" opened=$now
    on pop host window media-player
  details : column
    fold "Context"
    only when $context != ""
    words : text "$context_summary"
      role meta
  answer : column
    fold "Reply here"
    role response
    let recipient = $to when $name = "alex"
    let recipient = $name otherwise
    chatreply : text ""
      only when $what = "line"
      role composer
      hint "Reply in this conversation…"
      lines 2..8
      commit explicit
      on edit do append $item line="$value" default_to="$(recipient)" reply_to=$line
    commentreply : text ""
      only when $what = "comment"
      role composer
      hint "Reply on the original comment…"
      lines 2..8
      commit explicit
      on edit do reply $item id=$saying line="$value"
    threadreply : text ""
      only when $what = "reply"
      role composer
      hint "Reply on the original thread…"
      lines 2..8
      commit explicit
      on edit do reply $item id=$thread line="$value"
writing : column
  role dock
  activity : column
    of house doing=working
    each working
  audience : row
    label : text "To"
      role meta
    recipient : text "$to"
      share 1
      role recipient
      hint "Names separated by commas"
      commit enter only
      on edit do prop $item to="$value"
  people : row
    role shortcuts
    r : text "Rowan"
      role tool
      on click do prop $item to=rowan
    c : text "Claude"
      role tool
      on click do prop $item to=claude
    p : text "Pike"
      role tool
      on click do prop $item to=pike
    s : text "Sable"
      role tool
      on click do prop $item to=sable
    more : text "Codex"
      role tool
      on click do prop $item to=codex
  answering : row
    only when ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != ""
    label : text "Answering: $draft.quote"
      role meta
      share 1
      clamp 1
    place : text "in $draft.reply_in"
      role meta
    remove : text "×"
      role tool
      on click do prop $draft reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
  topic : column
    only when ($draft.reply_to or "") = "" and ($draft.reply_thread or "") = ""
    chip : row
      only when ($draft.topic or "") != ""
      label : text "About $draft.topic"
        role recipient
        share 1
        clamp 1
      lifetime : text "next message only"
        role meta
      remove : text "×"
        role tool
        tip "Remove context" "Send without the attached item"
        on click do prop $draft topic=""
  attachments : column
    of captures $draft.context
    each attachment
  say : text ""
    role composer
    hint "Write a message…"
    lines 3..10
    commit explicit
    on edit when ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "" do comment $draft.reply_in id=$draft.reply_thread line="$value"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
    on edit when ($draft.reply_thread or "") = "" and ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" and ($draft.reply_in or "") != "" and $draft.reply_in != "a5080" do append $draft.reply_in line="$value" reply_to="$draft.reply_to"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
    on edit when ($draft.reply_thread or "") = "" and (($draft.reply_to or "") = "" or ($draft.reply_in or "") = "" or $draft.reply_in = "a5080") and (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append a5080 line="$value" default_to="$draft.to" captures="$draft.context" context_from="$draft" reply_to="$draft.reply_to" about="$draft.topic"; read $draft; do prop $draft topic="" reply_to="" quote="" reply_in="" reply_thread="" reply_kind=""
    on edit when not (($draft.topic or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_to or "") != "" or ($draft.reply_thread or "") != "") do append a5080 line="$value" default_to="$draft.to" captures="$draft.context" context_from="$draft"
  help : text "Enter sends · Shift Enter adds a line · @name overrides To"
    role hint
attachment : column
  role attachment
  top : row
    label : text "$label"
      share 1
      role meta
    remove : text "Remove"
      role tool
      on click do prop $draft context="$remaining"
  details : column
    fold "Preview · $cid"
    summary : text "$summary"
      role meta
working : text "$resident is working • • •"
  only when $draft.to = $resident
  role activity
